text: Dave ate 14. The seagull ate 14 / 2 = 7. 3 pigeons ate 3 * 3 = 9. 2/3 of the remaining 14 - 7 - 9 = 8 is 2/3 * 8 = 5 1/3. So 8 - 5 1/3 = 2 2/3. The answer is 2 2/3.
Tom gets 4 car washes a month. So in a year he gets 4 x 12 = 48 car washes. Each car wash costs $15. So in a year he pays 48 x $15 = $720. The answer is $720.

Sean has to memorize the lyrics to a song with 54 lines. The first scene has twice the number of lines, but only a third of them are his lines. So the first scene has 2 * 54 = 108 lines. But only a third of them are his lines, so 108 / 3 = 36 lines. The second scene has six more lines than the song, so 54 + 6 = 60 lines. But only four-fifths of them are his lines, so 60 * 4/5 = 48 lines. The total number of lines Sean has to memorize is 54 + 36 + 48 = 138. The answer is 138.

Marilyn's first record sold 10 times as many copies as Harald's. So Marilyn's record sold 10 * x = 10x. Harald's record sold x. Together they sold 10x + x = 11x. We know that 11x = 88,000. So x = 8,000. The answer is 8,000.
Mico and Marco's ages are unknown. However, we know that the sum of their ages is 20. In 10 years, their ages will be 20 + 10 = 30. The answer is 30.

Grace weighs 125 pounds. Alex weighs 2 pounds less than 4 times what Grace weighs. So Alex weighs 4 * 125 - 2 = 500 - 2 = 498 pounds. Their combined weights are 125 + 498 = 623 pounds. The answer is 623.
Let's assume he had x hectares of land. He sold 3/5 of it, so he had 2/5 of it left. 2/5 * x = 12.8. x = 12.8 * 5/2 = 32. The answer is 32.
There are 60 letters needing stamps. One-third of them are stamped. 60 / 3 = 20. So there are 20 letters stamped. The answer is 20.
Raymond was born 6 years before Samantha. Samantha is now 31. So Raymond is now 31 - 6 = 25. Raymond had a son at the age of 23. So the son was born 25 - 23 = 2 years ago. The answer is 2.

John has 10 hectares of a pineapple field. There are 100 pineapples per hectare. So in total, John has 10 * 100 = 1000 pineapples. John can harvest his pineapples every 3 months. So in a year, he can harvest 12 / 3 = 4 times. 1000 * 4 = 4000. The answer is 4000.

The top level has a square footage of 16. The second level will have half the square footage of the top level, so it will have 16 / 2 = 8. The third level will have half the square footage of the second level, so it will have 8 / 2 = 4. The fourth level will have half the square footage of the third level, so it will have 4 / 2 = 2. The average square footage of a level is (16 + 8 + 4 + 2) / 4 = 30 / 4 = 7.5. The answer is 7.5.
In the first 20 minutes, he scores 4 points. In the second 20 minutes, he scores 25% more points. 25% of 4 is 1. So he scores 4 + 1 = 5 points in the second 20 minutes. 4 + 5 = 9. The answer is 9.
The 2 shirts cost $30 each. So the total cost is $30 * 2 = $60. The discount is 40%. So the discount is $60 * 40% = $24. The answer is $60 - $24 = $36.
There are 3 rows of 8 stars. 2 rows of 6 stars. 76 - (3 x 8) - (2 x 6) = 76 - 24 - 12 = 40. The answer is 40.
Isabelle spent $12 + $43 + $15 + $4 + $22 = $96. She split the cost evenly three ways. So each person paid $96 / 3 = $32. The answer is $32.

In the first month, the program had 60 downloads. In the second month, the number of downloads was 3 * 60 = 180. In the third month, the number of downloads was 180 - (0.3 * 180) = 180 - 54 = 126. The total number of downloads over the three months is 60 + 180 + 126 = 366. The answer is 366.

The opening bid is $200. Carmen bids $200 + $50 = $250. The next person bids $250 + $50 = $300. The next person bids $300 + $50 = $350. The next person bids $350 + $50 = $400. The next person bids $400 + $50 = $450. The next person bids $450 + $50 = $500. Carmen bids $500 + $50 = $550. The next person bids $550 + $50 = $600. Carmen bids $600 + $50 = $650. The next person bids $650 + $50 = $700. Carmen bids $700 + $50 = $750. The next person bids $750 + $50 = $800. Carmen bids $800 + $50 = $850. The next person bids $850 + $50 = $900.

There were 2 containers of imported vehicles, each having 5 vehicles inside. So there were 2 * 5 = 10 vehicles. After the next day, the total number of vehicles at the port became 30. So the number of vehicles imported on the second day is 30 - 10 = 20. The number of containers imported on the second day is 20 / 5 = 4. The answer is 4.
Kelly has 5 quarters and 2 dimes. 5 quarters = 5 * 25 = 125 cents. 2 dimes = 2 * 10 = 20 cents. So she has 125 + 20 = 145 cents. She buys a can of pop for 55 cents. 145 - 55 = 90. The answer is 90.
The city is 42 miles across. It takes 10 minutes to cover every 3 miles. So it will take 42 / 3 = 14. Then 14 x 10 = 140. The answer is 140.

The initial amount for the first half of the year is $140 x 6 = $840. The other half of the year is $140 x 6 = $840. The other half of the year is 10% less than the first half. 10% of $840 is $84. So the other half of the year is $840 - $84 = $756. The total amount she paid is $840 + $756 = $1596. The answer is $1596.
John drinks 5 glasses of water on weekdays. 5 x 5 = 25. On weekends, he drinks 1 glass of water. 25 + 1 = 26. The answer is 26.

Candice had 80 post-it notes before she went to work. She placed a single post-it note on each of 220 different cups of coffee. So she used 220 post-it notes. 220 + 80 = 300. She had 23 post-it notes remaining. So she had 300 - 23 = 277. The answer is 277.

The doll cost as much as 3 action figures and 1 red car. 3 action figures cost 3 * $5 = $15. 1 red car costs $4. So the doll costs $15 + $4 = $19. 5 red cars cost 5 * $4 = $20. 3 action figures cost 3 * $5 = $15. So all toys cost $20 + $15 + $19 = $54. The answer is $54.

The inner dimensions of each box are 5 - 1 = 4 inches, 6 - 1 = 5 inches, and 4 - 1 = 3 inches. The volume of one box is 4 * 5 * 3 = 60 cubic inches. Since there are 3 boxes, the total volume is 3 * 60 = 180 cubic inches. The answer is 180.

Axel has 50 silver pesos and 80 gold pesos. So he has 50 + 80 = 130 pesos. Anna has twice as many silver pesos as Axel. So she has 2 * 50 = 100 silver pesos. She has 40 more gold pesos than Axel. So she has 80 + 40 = 120 gold pesos. Anna has 100 + 120 = 220 pesos. Together they have 130 + 220 = 350 pesos. The answer is 350.
Chris has 6 trees. Ferdinand has 6 / 2 = 3 trees. Harry has 2 * 3 + 5 = 11 trees. The difference between Harry's and Ferdinand's trees is 11 - 3 = 8. The answer is 8.

Melanie sold a third of her vacuum cleaners at the green house. So she sold 1/3 of her vacuum cleaners. She sold 2 more to the red house. She sold half of what was left at the orange house. So she sold 1/2 of what was left. She has 5 vacuum cleaners left. So she started with 5 + 2 + 1/2 * 5 = 5 + 2 + 2.5 = 9.5. The answer is 9.5.

Eliza's rate per hour for the first 40 hours she works each week is $10. So for 40 hours she earns 40 * 10 = $400. She also receives an overtime pay of 1.2 times her regular hourly rate. So her overtime pay is 1.2 * 10 = $12. She worked for 45 hours this week. So she worked 45 - 40 = 5 hours overtime. Her overtime pay is 5 * 12 = $60. Her total earnings for this week are 400 + 60 = $460. The answer is $460.

Theo has $6000. He buys 6 business suits at $100 each. So he spends 6 * $100 = $600. He buys 3 suitcases at $50 each. So he spends 3 * $50 = $150. He buys a flight ticket that costs $700 more than 5 times as much as the cost of a business suit. So the flight ticket costs $100 * 5 + $700 = $1000. He wishes to save $2000 for this trip. So he has to spend $6000 - $2000 = $4000 on buying gifts for his business partners in South Africa. The answer is $4000.
There are 60 dogs. There are two cats for every dog. So there are 2 * 60 = 120 cats. The number of rabbits is 120 + 60 - 12 = 168. The total number of pets is 60 + 120 + 168 = 348. The answer is 348.

Initially, Elaine had 20 Pokemon cards. After a month, she collected three times that number. So she collected 3 * 20 = 60. In the second month, she collected 20 fewer cards than those she collected in the first month. So she collected 60 - 20 = 40. In the third month, she collected twice the combined number of pokemon cards she collected in the first and second months. So she collected 2 * (60 + 40) = 2 * 100 = 200. In total, she has 20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320. The answer is 320.

Annika brought $50 to the town fair. She spent half of it on food and snacks. Half of $50 is $25. She spent $25 on food and snacks. She spent an additional $10 for rides. So she spent $25 + $10 = $35. $50 - $35 = $15. The answer is $15.

A watermelon costs 3 * 15 = 45$. An orange costs 45 - 5 = 40$. 4 watermelons cost 4 * 45 = 180$. 20 peppers cost 20 * 15 = 300$. 10 oranges cost 10 * 40 = 400$. The total cost is 180 + 300 + 400 = 880$. The answer is 880$.

Dean's mother gave him $28. He bought 6 toy cars and 5 teddy bears. Each toy car cost $2 and each teddy bear cost $1. So he spent 6 * 2 + 5 * 1 = 12 + 5 = 17. His mother then gave him an extra $10. So he had 28 + 10 = 38. He spent 17. So he has 38 - 17 = 21. The answer is 21.
There are 6 rows and 6 columns. So there are 6 * 6 = 36 books. Wendy wants to place 20 more than double the number of books. So she needs 2 * 36 + 20 = 72 + 20 = 92. The answer is 92.

Mrs. Sherman made 12 bread rolls. She fed 6 children with one each. So she had 12 - 6 = 6 rolls left. She broke each of the remaining rolls into 8 pieces. So she had 6 * 8 = 48 pieces of rolls. The answer is 48.
The winner got 3/4 of the votes. So the loser got 1/4 of the votes. 1/4 of 80 is 20. The answer is 20.
To find the average, we need to add all the numbers and divide by the number of numbers. 65 + 94 + 81 + 86 + 74 = 400. 400 / 5 = 80. The answer is 80.

In the first 6 hours, Debra saw 30 bees leave the hive. In the next 6 hours, she saw 1/2 that many bees return. 1/2 * 30 = 15. So she saw 15 bees return. In the next 6 hours, she saw two times as many bees as she saw first leave the hive fly from the hive and leave. 2 * 30 = 60. So she saw 60 bees leave. Then every bee that left before that hadn't already returned returns to the hive in the next 6 hours. So she saw 60 bees return. The answer is 60.

Each picture frame needs to be etched with the logo for an additional 20% cost per frame.  2 of the seniors will also receive pins that are $5.  1/4 of the seniors are officers and they will need to receive cords that are $12 each.

There were originally 30 cars on the motorway. 5 cars took an exit. So there were 30 - 5 = 25 cars left. 20 cars drove through in the remaining 15 minutes. So 25 - 20 = 5 cars drove through in the first 15 minutes. The answer is 5.

There are 4 snails in one aquarium and 32 snails in another aquarium. The difference between the number of snails in the two aquariums is 32 - 4 = 28. This is twice the amount of fish in both aquariums. So the amount of fish in both aquariums is 28 / 2 = 14. The answer is 14.
There are 50 socks that need washing. Lindsay washes 10 pairs of socks. 10 pairs = 20 socks. She also washes 15 loose socks. 20 + 15 = 35. 50 - 35 = 15. The answer is 15.

Jill gets paid $20 per hour to teach. She works 35 hours a week. So her salary for teaching is 35 * 20 = $700. She gets paid $30 per hour to be a coach. She works 15 hours a week. So her salary for coaching is 15 * 30 = $450. Her total salary is 700 + 450 = $1150. The answer is $1150.
Johnny had $20. He added $10. So he had $20 + $10 = $30. After a year, it tripled. So he had $30 * 3 = $90. The answer is $90.

Tommy sells 43 brownies for $3 a slice. So he makes 43 * 3 = $129. Tommy sells 23 slices of cheesecake for $4 a slice. So he makes 23 * 4 = $92. In total, Tommy makes 129 + 92 = $221. The answer is $221.

Adrien's salary four years ago was $40000. His salary four years later was 40% more than his salary four years ago. So his salary four years later was 40% of $40000 + $40000. 40% of $40000 = $16000. $40000 + $16000 = $56000. Lylah's salary four years ago was 30% less than Adrien's. So Lylah's salary four years ago was 30% of $40000 - $40000. 30% of $40000 = $12000. $40000 - $12000 = $28000. Four years later, Lylah's salary was 40% more than her salary four years ago. So Lylah's salary four years later was 40% of $28000 + $28000. 40% of $28000 = $11200

Steve lives 3 miles away from the school. 3 miles = 15840 feet. At 440 feet per minute, it will take Steve 15840 / 440 = 36 minutes to get home. Tim lives 2 miles away from the school. 2 miles = 10560 feet. At 264 feet per minute, it will take Tim 10560 / 264 = 40 minutes to get home. Steve will be waiting 40 - 36 = 4 minutes. The answer is 4.

There are 2 houses. Each house has 3 bedrooms. So there are 2 * 3 = 6 bedrooms. Each bedroom has 2 windows. So there are 6 * 2 = 12 windows. There are 4 additional windows in each house. So there are 2 * 4 = 8 windows. 12 + 8 = 20. The answer is 20.

Jessa is 20 years old. Joan is 5 years older than Jessa. So Joan is 20 + 5 = 25. Mary is 2 years younger than Joan. So Mary is 25 - 2 = 23. The sum of the ages of the three girls is 20 + 25 + 23 = 68. The answer is 68.

Janet originally had 22 green pens and 10 yellow pens. She bought 6 bags of blue pens and 2 bags of red pens. There were 9 pens in each bag of blue and 6 pens in each bag of red. So she bought 6 * 9 = 54 blue pens and 2 * 6 = 12 red pens. In total, she has 22 + 10 + 54 + 12 = 98 pens. The answer is 98.

Let's assume they lost x games. Then they won x + 8 games. Since they played 22 games, x + (x + 8) = 22. Solving for x, we get 2x + 8 = 22, 2x = 14, x = 7. So they lost 7 games and won 7 + 8 = 15 games. The answer is 15.
Jean has 30 lollipops. She eats 2. So she has 30 - 2 = 28. She wants to package 2 lollipops in one bag. So she can fill 28 / 2 = 14 bags. The answer is 14.

The ratio of Betty's popsicles to Sam's popsicles is 5:6. So Betty has 5 parts and Sam has 6 parts. The total number of parts is 5 + 6 = 11. The total number of popsicles is 165. So each part is 165 / 11 = 15. Betty has 5 * 15 = 75 popsicles. Sam has 6 * 15 = 90 popsicles. Sam has 90 - 75 = 15 more popsicles than Betty. The answer is 15.
The first bag has 300 M&Ms. The second bag has 300 + 12 = 312. The third bag has 300 / 2 = 150. So in total, Mary had 300 + 312 + 150 = 762. The answer is 762.

Henry traveled 60 miles in total. He first stopped after 20 miles. His second stop was 15 miles before the end of the trip. So he traveled 60 - 20 - 15 = 25 miles between his first and second stops. The answer is 25.

The first box had 500 pieces. The second box had 3 times more pieces than the first box, so it had 3 * 500 = 1500 pieces. The third box had 1/4 the number of pieces as the first box, so it had 500 / 4 = 125 pieces. In total, Johnny picked up 500 + 1500 + 125 = 2125 pieces. The answer is 2125.
The wire was 4 feet long. 1 foot = 12 inches. So 4 feet = 4 x 12 = 48 inches. The wire was cut into pieces 6 inches long. So the number of pieces = 48 / 6 = 8. The answer is 8.

Morisette brought 5 apples and 8 oranges. So she brought 5 + 8 = 13 fruits. Kael brought twice the amount of apples and half the number of oranges than Morisette. So he brought 2 * 5 = 10 apples and 8 / 2 = 4 oranges. So he brought 10 + 4 = 14 fruits. In total, they brought 13 + 14 = 27 fruits. The answer is 27.

James has 30 fire type, 20 grass type, and 40 water type. So in total he has 30 + 20 + 40 = 90. After losing 8 of the water type, he has 40 - 8 = 32 water type. After buying 14 grass type, he has 20 + 14 = 34 grass type. So now he has 30 + 34 + 32 = 96. The percentage chance that a randomly picked card will be a water type is (32/96) * 100 = 33.33%. Rounded to the nearest integer, it is 33%. The answer is 33%.
On Tuesday, she had 1 hour of dance practice. On Thursday, she had 2 hours. On Saturday, she had 2 * 1 = 2 hours. So in total, she had 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 hours. The answer is 5.

The ratio of teaspoons of sugar to cups of water is 7:13. So for every 7 teaspoons of sugar, there are 13 cups of water. The total number of parts in the ratio is 7 + 13 = 20. The total number of teaspoons of sugar and cups of water used is 120. So the number of teaspoons of sugar used is (7/20) * 120 = 42. The answer is 42.
Bailey receives $5 weekly for 8 weeks. So she receives $5 * 8 = $40. If she has $100 at the end of the 8 weeks, she must have had $100 - $40 = $60 at the beginning. The answer is $60.

Each person consumes 0.2 kg of rice every meal. So 5 people will consume 5 * 0.2 = 1 kg of rice every meal. Since they eat lunch and dinner, they will consume 1 * 2 = 2 kg of rice every day. A 42 kg bag of rice will last 42 / 2 = 21 days. Since there are 7 days in a week, the bag will last 21 / 7 = 3 weeks. The answer is 3.

Luke ate 2 hot dogs. Thomas ate 3 times more than Luke. So Thomas ate 3 * 2 = 6 hot dogs. John ate half the amount Thomas ate. So John ate 6 / 2 = 3 hot dogs. John ate 3 - 2 = 1 more hot dog than Luke. The answer is 1.
There are 16 balls. Half of the balls are golf balls. So there are 16 / 2 = 8 golf balls. Half of the golf balls are blue. So there are 8 / 2 = 4 blue golf balls. The answer is 4.

On Monday, Robert collects 20 shells. Kylie collects 5 more than Robert. So Kylie collects 20 + 5 = 25. On Tuesday, Kylie collects 2 times more than she did on Monday. So Kylie collects 2 * 25 = 50. The answer is 50.

Griffin had 24 fries. Kyle took 5. Billy took 2 * 5 = 10. So 24 - 5 - 10 = 9. Then, let's say x is the number of fries Ginger gave Griffin. Then, Colby took 3 less than 5, which is 2. So, 9 + x + 2 = 27. 11 + x = 27. x = 16. The answer is 16.

The Doubtfire sisters have 7 adopted kittens. The first cat has had thrice the number of adopted kittens. So the first cat has had 3 * 7 = 21 kittens. The second cat has had 12 kittens. So in total, the Doubtfire family has 7 + 21 + 12 = 40 kittens. The answer is 40.

Mary has 30 sheep. Half of them is 30 / 2 = 15. She gets 1 kg of milk from 15 sheep. So she gets 15 * 1 = 15 kg of milk from the first half. She gets 2 kg of milk from the other half. So she gets 15 * 2 = 30 kg of milk from the second half. In total, she gets 15 + 30 = 45 kg of milk every day. The answer is 45.

Lloyd earns $10 an hour. He tutored 5 hours for the first week. So he earned 5 * 10 = $50. He tutored 8 hours for the second week. So he earned 8 * 10 = $80. In total, he earned $50 + $80 = $130. The answer is $130.

The first train travels 80 miles in the first day and 150 miles in the second day. So the total distance covered by the first train is 80 + 150 = 230 miles. The second train travels 150 miles in the first day and 80 miles in the second day. So the total distance covered by the second train is 150 + 80 = 230 miles. The answer is 230 miles.

Mike was a pen pal with 5 people. He stopped being penpals with 2 of them. So he is still a pen pal with 5 - 2 = 3 people. They each send 2 letters a week. So in total they send 3 * 2 = 6 letters a week. Each letter is 5 pages long. So in total they send 6 * 5 = 30 pages a week. He can write a page every 6 minutes. So in a week, he can write 30 * 60 * 6 = 10800 minutes. 10800 minutes is 180 hours. The answer is 180.

Each can of tomatoes contains 3 tomatoes. Each can has a volume of 16 ounces. When Freda cooks the tomatoes, they lose half their volume. So each can of tomatoes becomes 16 / 2 = 8 ounces. 32 ounces of sauce is made from 32 / 8 = 4 cans of tomatoes. 4 cans of tomatoes contain 4 * 3 = 12 tomatoes. The answer is 12.

The bridge can carry 5000 pounds. The driver and the empty truck weigh 3755 pounds. So the maximum weight the truck can carry is 5000 - 3755 = 1245 pounds. Each box weighs 15 pounds. So the maximum number of boxes the truck can carry is 1245 / 15 = 83. The answer is 83.

The gas station is selling gas for $3.00 a gallon.  An app company is offering $.20 cashback per gallon if you fill up at this station.  If someone buys 10 gallons of gas, how much with their gas be, after the cashback rewards? 10 * $3.00 = $30.00. 10 * $.20 = $2.00. $30.00 - $2.00 = $28.00. The answer is $28.00.
Marcell's total is 3 * 14 = 42. Beatrice's total is 2 * 24 = 48. The average is (42 + 48) / 2 = 45. The answer is 45.

Josh bought the house for $80,000. He put in $50,000 in repairs. So the total cost was $80,000 + $50,000 = $130,000. The value of the house increased by 150%. So the new value of the house was $130,000 * 1.5 = $195,000. The profit was $195,000 - $130,000 = $65,000. The answer is $65,000.
Nancy owes $0.50 cents for each book. She has 8 books. So she owes 8 * $0.50 = $4.00. She also owes a flat $2.00 fee. So in total she owes $4.00 + $2.00 = $6.00. The answer is $6.00.

Six years ago, Cera was 46 - 6 = 40 years old. At that time, Noah was half as old as Cera, so Noah was 40 / 2 = 20 years old. The population of Chile six years ago was 3000 times the age of Noah, so the population of Chile six years ago was 3000 * 20 = 60000. The population of Chile now is 60000 * 2 = 120000. The answer is 120000.

The fourth friend pressed on the doorbell 60 times. The third friend pressed on the doorbell 10 times more than the fourth friend. So the third friend pressed on the doorbell 60 + 10 = 70 times. The second friend pressed on the doorbell 1/4 times more than Jerome's first friend. So the second friend pressed on the doorbell 20 + (1/4 * 20) = 20 + 5 = 25 times. The first friend pressed on the doorbell 20 times. The total number of doorbell rings is 20 + 25 + 70 + 60 = 175. The answer is 175.

Let's say there are x players on the defense. Then there are 2x players on the offense. And there are x/2 players on the special teams. The total number of players is 105. So we can write the equation: x + 2x + x/2 = 105. Solving for x, we get x = 30. The answer is 30.
Sally Four is 8 years old. Granny Red is 2 * 8 = 16 years old. Sally Two is 16 + 3 = 19 years old. The total age of the four birds is 8 + 16 + 19 + 8 = 51. The answer is 51.

Let's denote the number of birds in Jamal's photograph of the ducks at the zoo as x. Then, the maximum number of photographs that Brittany's phone can hold is 50x. Since Jamal's phone can hold 1800 photographs, and it can hold 6 times more photographs than Brittany's phone, we have 1800 = 6 * 50x. Solving for x, we get x = 1800 / (6 * 50) = 1800 / 300 = 6. The answer is 6.

The whiteboard is shared by 4 teachers. Each teacher has 2 lessons per day. So in total, there are 4 x 2 = 8 lessons per day. Each lesson requires 3 times cleaning. So the whiteboard is cleaned 8 x 3 = 24 times per day. The answer is 24.
The coffee is cooled by 65 degrees. 65 / 13 = 5. The coffee is 5 times weaker. 5 * 12 = 60. The coffee is 60 milliliters weaker. The answer is 60.

Carlos rents a canoe for $30 an hour. He uses it for 3 hours. So he pays 30 * 3 = $90. Benji rents a banana boat raft for $18 an hour. He uses it for 5 hours. So he pays 18 * 5 = $90. The total cost is 90 + 90 = $180. The answer is $180.

Annabelle already has $80. She earns $10 per hour at her first job. She works 20 hours. So she earns 20 * $10 = $200. She earns $5 per hour at her second job. She works 15 hours. So she earns 15 * $5 = $75. In total, she earns $200 + $75 = $275. She needs $400 - $275 = $125. The answer is $125.

Baldur gets 5 pails of water every morning. 6 pails of water every afternoon. So he gets 5 + 6 = 11 pails of water every day. Each pail contains 5 liters of water. So he gets 11 * 5 = 55 liters of water every day. The answer is 55.
John collects peaches for 3 hours.  He can collect 2 peaches a minute.  So he collects 2 * 60 = 120 peaches in 1 hour.  In 3 hours, he collects 120 * 3 = 360 peaches. The answer is 360.

If he buys 18 flowers in packages of 3, he will pay 18 / 3 * $2.50 = 6 * $2.50 = $15. If he buys 18 flowers in packages of 2, he will pay 18 / 2 * $1 = 9 * $1 = $9. He saves $15 - $9 = $6. The answer is $6.

Mitchel went down the slide 30 times. Anne went down 30% less than Mitchel. 30% of 30 is 9. So Anne went down 30 - 9 = 21 times. Robert went down 4 times as much as Anne. 4 * 21 = 84. The answer is 84.

Mark has $50 in his bank account. He earns $10 per day. So he has $50 + $10 = $60 per day. He needs $300. So he needs to save $300 - $60 = $240. He needs to save $240 / $10 = 24 days. The answer is 24.
Job A pays $15 an hour for 2000 hours a year. So it pays $15 * 2000 = $30,000 a year. Job B pays $42,000 a year. So job B pays more.

Jerry is rolling a six-sided die. The probability of rolling a number greater than 3 is 3/6 = 1/2. The probability of rolling two even numbers in a row is 1/4. The difference in probability is 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4. The answer is 25%.

The pink frog weighs 50 pounds. The blue beetle weighs 50 pounds. The green toad weighs 50 pounds. The yellow snake weighs 50 + 10 = 60 pounds. The red bird weighs 50 - 20 = 30 pounds. The total weight of the animals is 50 + 50 + 50 + 60 + 30 = 240 pounds. The container weighs 20 pounds. The total weight of the animals and the container is 240 + 20 = 260 pounds. The answer is 260.

Zaid's salary is 6000$. He spends 1/4 of his salary on rent. 1/4 of 6000$ = 1500$. He spends 1/3 of his salary on car fuel. 1/3 of 6000$ = 2000$. So he spends 1500$ + 2000$ = 3500$ on rent and car fuel. He donates half of the remaining amount to his favorite charity. The remaining amount is 6000$ - 3500$ = 2500$. Half of 2500$ = 1250$. So he donates 1250$ to his favorite charity. He gives his daughter 200$ to use for her weekly expenses. He gives his wife 700$ to budget for groceries and other household goods. So he gives his daughter 200$ + 700$ = 900$. The remaining amount is 2500$ - 1250$ - 900$ = 350$. The answer is

John has 13 lego sets. He sells them for $15 each. So he gets 13 * 15 = $195. He buys 8 video games for $20 each. So he spends 8 * 20 = $160. He has $5 left. So he spent 195 - 160 - 5 = $30. The answer is 13.
